seo.description: Learn about Headache Disorders — symptoms, causes, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment options, and prevention tips.

overview: Headache is pain in the head or neck region. Tension-type and migraine headaches are most common. Sudden severe headache or headache with neurological signs requires urgent evaluation.
symptoms: Dull aching (tension) or throbbing unilateral pain (migraine)
causes: Tension-type headache from stress or muscle strain
diagnosis: Neuroimaging if red flags: sudden onset, age >50 new headache, focal neurological signs
treatment: Paracetamol or ibuprofen for acute episodes
complications: Missed secondary cause if red flags ignored

faqs.question: What causes Headache Disorders?
faqs.answer: Multiple factors including genetics, lifestyle, and environment contribute.

faqs.question: Is Headache Disorders curable?
faqs.answer: Many conditions are manageable with proper treatment. Consult your doctor for prognosis.
